batch: ASH MCP default account confirmation scope
behavior: None resolves active simulated owner accounts and filters auto-trading eligibility; explicit empty scope reads no accounts.
Invalid IDs, duplicate/count-mismatched or malformed upstream rows block before confirmation.
Opt-in manifest confirmation_commit_argument_bindings binds a deep copy of resolved IDs to commit; dispatcher also copies input, pending and audit data.
Backend confirmation revalidates owner, active/type/auto-enabled eligibility and permission; post-preview newly eligible accounts stay outside the frozen scope.
The SDK preserves actual upstream HTTP status on shared exception subclasses without changing constructor defaults or signatures.
limits: HTTP journeys use synthetic owners and disposable SQLite no-migrations schema; they do not qualify production, PostgreSQL concurrency or a broker.
The HTTP execution engine is a typed no-op spy. Tests qualify exact submitted account IDs and permission/state revalidation, not actual trades or market-calendar correctness.

The current account-list API returns all matching owner rows and ignores limit. All returned rows/counts are validated, but this is not an independent source-size bound or proof against future truncation.
Explicit and resolved account ID lists are capped at 10000; samples are capped at ten. Full resolved IDs and canonical ordered SHA256 remain in preview.
Confirmation, idempotency and audit remain process-local; this adds no durable deduplication, exactly-once guarantee or restart recovery.
Permission validation covers current server-side MCP profile revocation. Cached role downgrade is not qualified.
No model, schema, route, dependency, TUI metadata or generated projection content changes. C3c import outcome semantics remain open.
Full ASH01-12 Goal, qualified ordinary settlement, PIT/source, real broker, production, RC and S6 remain open.
retained_failures_and_limits: Actual first-pass RED: 26 SDK failures, HTTP 2 failed/6 passed, auth-status 1 failed/10 passed. Source stayed old until these completed.

Initial formatted production source failed strict SDK mypy on one Optional list. Root cancelled exactly two first-pass pytest children; their partial runs are not acceptance and cancellation/process/log records are retained.

The explicit post-preview None guard fixes narrowing without ignore, cast or debt changes. Production-level checks bind source02; final SDK and style checks bind source03, which only adds a corrected old test fixture and preserves every source02 production byte.
Initial Black formatting reported Windows Errno22 for manifest.py. Direct verbose formatting and the serial retry formatter completed; the OS root cause is not qualified and original logs remain.

The author packet retains its original 22d6ecea label; Root independently checked every target preimage against actual 5c4fb9b5 and both patches before admission. It is not relabelled as a new author packet.

The second full SDK run was explicitly cancelled after an old account fixture failed; one dedicated diagnostic node failed independently. The source03 fix changes only its get_account mapping and preserves all 16 assertions and the other eight tests. The final complete SDK suite uses four isolated xdist workers; canceled partial runs are not acceptance.

+def _is_supported_integer_array_schema(schema: object) -> bool:
+    """Return whether a schema declares an integer array, optionally nullable."""
+
+    if type(schema) is not dict:

+    mapping = {"account_ids": "resolved_account_ids"} if bindings is None else cast(Any, bindings)
+    return CapabilityManifest(

+        summary="Preview then confirm a scope.",

+        owner_app="test",
+        risk_level="high",
+        executor_kind="internal_handler",
+        executor_ref="freeze_scope",
+        input_schema={
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {
+                "account_ids": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"type": "integer"}},
+                "idempotency_key": {"type": "string"},
+            },
+            "required": [],
+        },
+        output_schema={
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {
+                "resolved_account_ids": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}},

+def _dispatcher(preview_value: object, committed: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> CapabilityDispatcher:

+"""Preserve actual HTTP status while retaining SDK exception compatibility."""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from agomtradepro.exceptions import (
+    AgomTradeProAPIError,
+    AuthenticationError,
+    raise_for_status,
+)
+
+
+def test_authentication_error_default_status_remains_401() -> None:
+    """Direct construction retains its historical default."""
+    assert AuthenticationError().status_code == 401
+
+
+def test_authentication_error_legacy_positional_response_stays_supported() -> None:
+    """The two existing positional constructor arguments keep their meanings."""
+    response: dict[str, Any] = {"detail": "Not authorized"}
+    error = AuthenticationError("Legacy message", response)
+    assert error.status_code == 401
+    assert error.message == "Legacy message"
+    assert error.response is response
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", [401, 403])
+def test_http_authentication_error_keeps_exact_upstream_status(status: int) -> None:
+    """Shared authentication subclasses must retain the actual HTTP status."""
+    response: dict[str, Any] = {"error": "MCP access disabled"}
+    with pytest.raises(AuthenticationError) as caught:
+        raise_for_status(status, response)
+    assert caught.value.status_code == status
+    assert caught.value.code == f"http_{status}"
+    assert caught.value.message == response["error"]
+    assert caught.value.response is response
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", [400, 404, 409, 418, 429, 500, 503])
+def test_other_http_errors_keep_status_code_and_response(status: int) -> None:
+    """Preserving shared-class status does not alter other HTTP error receipts."""
+    response: dict[str, Any] = {"code": "PUBLIC_DENIAL", "message": "Request rejected"}
+    with pytest.raises(AgomTradeProAPIError) as caught:
+        raise_for_status(status, response)
+    assert caught.value.status_code == status
+    assert caught.value.code == "public_denial"
+    assert caught.value.response is response

+@pytest.fixture
+def exact_origin_http_log(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, live_server: Any) -> _HttpLog:
+    """Allow real requests to only the exact local live_server origin."""
+
+    parts = urlsplit(str(live_server.url))
+    host = str(parts.hostname or "").lower().rstrip(".")
+    expected = (parts.scheme.lower(), host, _effective_port(parts))
+    assert host and expected[0] == "http"
+    for name in (
+        "HTTP_PROXY",
+        "HTTPS_PROXY",
+        "ALL_PROXY",
+        "http_proxy",
+        "https_proxy",
+        "all_proxy",
+    ):
+        monkeypatch.delenv(name, raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("NO_PROXY", host)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("no_proxy", host)
+
+    log = _HttpLog(expected_origin=expected, exchanges=[], blocked=[])
+    original_request = requests.Session.request
+
+    def guarded_request(
+        session: requests.Session,
+        method: str,
+        url: str,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> requests.Response:
+        """Reject a non-local origin before I/O and preserve actual local responses."""
+
+        parsed = urlsplit(str(url))
+        actual = (
+            parsed.scheme.lower(),
+            str(parsed.hostname or "").lower().rstrip("."),
+            _effective_port(parsed),
+        )
+        if actual != expected:
+            log.blocked.append(actual)
+            raise AssertionError("HTTP request escaped the exact live_server origin")
+
+        response = original_request(session, method, url, **kwargs)
+        body = kwargs.get("json")
+        try:
+            response_body = response.json()
+        except ValueError:
+            response_body = None
+        log.exchanges.append(
+            {
+                "method": method.upper(),
+                "path": parsed.path,
+                "origin": f"{actual[0]}://{actual[1]}:{actual[2]}",
+                "status": response.status_code,
+                "content_type": response.headers.get("Content-Type", ""),
+                "request_json": dict(body) if isinstance(body, dict) else None,
+                "response_json": (
+                    response_body if isinstance(response_body, (dict, list)) else None
+                ),
+            }
+        )
+        return response
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", guarded_request)
+    return log

+def _resume(mcp_runtime: _McpRuntime, staged: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Approve one actual dispatcher confirmation token."""
+
+    assert staged["status"] == "confirmation_required"
+    token = staged.get("confirmation_token")
+    assert isinstance(token, str) and token
+    return mcp_runtime.dispatcher.resume_confirmation(confirmation_token=token, approve=True)
+

+def _exchanges(log: _HttpLog, *, method: str, path: str) -> list[_Exchange]:
+    """Select observed requests without substituting any response."""
+
+    return [
+        exchange
+        for exchange in log.exchanges
+        if exchange["method"] == method and exchange["path"] == path
+    ]
+
+
+def _account_reads(log: _HttpLog) -> list[_Exchange]:
+    """Return real account-list and account-detail GETs from the API log."""
+
+    return [
+        exchange
+        for exchange in log.exchanges
+        if exchange["method"] == "GET" and exchange["path"].startswith(ACCOUNT_LIST_PATH)
+    ]
+
+
+def _assert_json_response(exchange: _Exchange, status: int) -> None:
+    assert exchange["status"] == status
+    assert exchange["content_type"].startswith("application/json")
+
+
+def _assert_http_guard(log: _HttpLog) -> None:
+    assert log.blocked == [("https", "outside.invalid", 443)]
+    assert all(
+        exchange["origin"]
+        == f"{log.expected_origin[0]}://{log.expected_origin[1]}:{log.expected_origin[2]}"
+        for exchange in log.exchanges
+    )

+def test_default_scope_freezes_only_accounts_resolved_before_confirmation(
+    mcp_runtime: _McpRuntime,
+    accounts: _Accounts,
+    engine_spy: _EngineSpy,
+    exact_origin_http_log: _HttpLog,
+) -> None:
+    """A newly eligible account after preview is not added to the confirmed run."""
+
+    before_trades = SimulatedTradeModel.objects.count()
+    staged = _stage_default_scope(mcp_runtime)
+    assert staged["status"] == "confirmation_required"
+    assert staged["preview_result"]["account_ids"] is None
+    lists = _exchanges(exact_origin_http_log, method="GET", path=ACCOUNT_LIST_PATH)
+    assert len(lists) == 1
+    _assert_json_response(lists[0], 200)
+
+    added = _create_account(
+        mcp_runtime.principal.owner,
+        f"added-after-preview-{uuid4().hex[:10]}",
+    )
+    assert added.pk != accounts.eligible.pk
+
+    result = _resume(mcp_runtime, staged)
+    assert result["status"] == "completed"
+    posts = _exchanges(exact_origin_http_log, method="POST", path=AUTO_RUN_PATH)
+    assert len(posts) == 1
+    _assert_json_response(posts[0], 200)
+    assert engine_spy.calls == [(TRADE_DATE, (accounts.eligible.pk,))], (
+        "confirmation included an account added after preview: "
+        f"observed execution IDs {engine_spy.calls!r}"
+    )
+    resolved_ids = [accounts.eligible.pk]
+    assert staged["preview_result"]["resolved_account_ids"] == resolved_ids
+    scope_summary = staged["preview_result"]["account_scope_summary"]
+    assert scope_summary["scope_mode"] == "default"
+    assert scope_summary["requested_account_count"] is None
+    assert scope_summary["source_account_count"] == 2
+    assert scope_summary["resolved_account_count"] == len(resolved_ids)
+    expected_digest = hashlib.sha256(
+        json.dumps(resolved_ids, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode("utf-8")
+    ).hexdigest()
+    assert scope_summary["resolved_account_ids_sha256"] == expected_digest
+    assert posts[0]["request_json"] == {
+        "trade_date": TRADE_DATE.isoformat(),
+        "account_ids": [accounts.eligible.pk],
+    }
+    assert result["result"]["outcome"] == "noop"
+    assert SimulatedTradeModel.objects.count() == before_trades
+    added_detail_path = f"{ACCOUNT_LIST_PATH}{added.pk}/"
+    assert not _exchanges(exact_origin_http_log, method="GET", path=added_detail_path)
+    _assert_http_guard(exact_origin_http_log)

"""Bind eight owned paths through two auxiliary indexes; preserve the main index."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
tmp = root / '.tmp'
manifest = json.loads((tmp / 'ash-mcp-scope-final-source-03.json').read_text())
base = manifest['base_head']
paths = manifest['source_paths']

def git(*args, env=None):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-optional-locks', *args], cwd=root,
                            env=env, capture_output=True, check=True)
    return result.stdout

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

index = root / git('rev-parse', '--git-path', 'index').decode().rstrip('\r\n')
before = digest(index.read_bytes())
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().rstrip('\r\n') == base
assert git('branch', '--show-current').decode().rstrip('\r\n') == 'dev/next-development'
assert not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
for row in manifest['files']:
    assert digest((root / row['path']).read_bytes()) == row['raw_sha256'], row['path']

records = []
for name in ['ash-mcp-scope-source-index-03', 'ash-mcp-scope-source-replay-index-03']:
    auxiliary = tmp / name
    assert not auxiliary.exists()
    env = dict(os.environ, GIT_INDEX_FILE=str(auxiliary))
    git('read-tree', base, env=env)
    if not records:
        git('add', '--', *paths, env=env)
        patch = git('diff', '--cached', '--binary', '--full-index', base, '--', *paths, env=env)
        output = tmp / 'ash-mcp-scope-final-source-03.patch'
        assert not output.exists()
        output.write_bytes(patch)
    else:
        git('apply', '--cached', '--check', str(output), env=env)
        git('apply', '--cached', str(output), env=env)
    changed = git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only', base, env=env).decode().splitlines()
    assert set(changed) == set(paths), changed
    tree = git('write-tree', env=env).decode().rstrip('\r\n')
    records.append({'index': str(auxiliary), 'tree': tree, 'paths': changed})
assert records[0]['tree'] == records[1]['tree']
assert before == digest(index.read_bytes())
assert not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
record = {'base_head': base, 'source_tree': tree,
          'patch': str(output.relative_to(root)), 'patch_raw_sha256': digest(output.read_bytes()),
          'main_index_unchanged': True, 'main_index_raw_sha256': before,
          'replays': records, 'source_manifest_raw_sha256': digest((tmp / 'ash-mcp-scope-final-source-03.json').read_bytes())}
out = tmp / 'ash-mcp-scope-source-binding-03.json'
assert not out.exists()
out.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(record, indent=2))

"""Capture one explicitly authorized Fee MCP default scope check; no source or Git mutations."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--tag", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--cwd", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-manifest", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--window-record", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    manifest_path = Path(args.source_manifest).resolve()
    window_path = Path(args.window_record).resolve()
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    window = json.loads(window_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if window.get("owner") != "a-share-usability" or window.get("status") != "returned":
        raise RuntimeError("An explicit returned shared-window record is required")
    command = args.command[1:] if args.command[:1] == ["--"] else args.command
    if not command or not args.tag.replace("-", "").isalnum():
        raise ValueError("Use one explicit command and an alphanumeric/hyphen tag")
    output = root / ".tmp" / f"ash-mcp-scope-{args.tag}.json"
    log = output.with_suffix(".log")
    if output.exists() or log.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Prior command results are immutable; use a new tag")
    sources = {row["path"]: row["raw_sha256"] for row in manifest["files"]}

    def verify() -> None:
        for relative, expected in sources.items():
            path = (root / relative).resolve()
            if not path.is_relative_to(root) or digest(path) != expected:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Source drift: {relative}")

    verify()
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8="1", PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8", PYTEST_ADDOPTS="")
    env.update(manifest.get("environment", {}))
    started = time.monotonic()
    with log.open("xb") as stream:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=args.cwd, env=env, stdout=stream,
                                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
    record = {
        "phase": args.tag, "command": command, "cwd": args.cwd,
        "exit_code": result.returncode, "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
        "source_manifest": str(manifest_path), "source_manifest_raw_sha256": digest(manifest_path),
        "window_record_raw_sha256": digest(window_path), "driver_raw_sha256": digest(Path(__file__)),
        "log": str(log), "log_raw_sha256": digest(log), "sources": sources,
    }
    output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    verify()
    print(json.dumps(record, indent=2), flush=True)
    return result.returncode


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

+def _normalize_simulated_auto_trading_account_ids(account_ids: object) -> list[int] | None:
+    """Validate an optional ordered account ID list at the MCP boundary."""
+
+    if account_ids is None:
+        return None
+    if type(account_ids) is not list:
+        raise ValueError("account_ids must be a list of positive integers or omitted.")
+    if len(account_ids) > _MAX_AUTO_TRADING_ACCOUNT_SCOPE_SIZE:
+        raise ValueError("account_ids exceeds the supported simulated account scope size.")
+    normalized: list[int] = []
+    seen: set[int] = set()
+    for account_id in account_ids:
+        if type(account_id) is not int or account_id <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("account_ids must contain only positive integers.")
+        if account_id in seen:
+            raise ValueError("account_ids must not contain duplicates.")
+        seen.add(account_id)
+        normalized.append(account_id)
+    return normalized
+
+
+def _validate_simulated_auto_trading_account(
+    account: object,
+    *,
+    expected_account_id: int | None,
+    require_auto_trading: bool,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate an account record and return its safe preview summary."""
+
+    if type(account) is not dict:
+        raise ValueError("The account service returned a malformed account record.")
+    account_id = account.get("account_id")
+    account_name = account.get("account_name")
+    account_type = account.get("account_type")
+    is_active = account.get("is_active")
+    auto_enabled = account.get("auto_trading_enabled")
+    if type(account_id) is not int or account_id <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("The account service returned an invalid account ID.")
+    if expected_account_id is not None and account_id != expected_account_id:
+        raise ValueError("The account service returned a different account than requested.")
+    if type(account_name) is not str or not account_name.strip():
+        raise ValueError("The account service returned an invalid account name.")
+    if account_type != "simulated" or is_active is not True:
+        raise ValueError("The requested account is not an active simulated account.")
+    if type(auto_enabled) is not bool:
+        raise ValueError("The account service did not confirm auto-trading eligibility.")
+    if require_auto_trading and not auto_enabled:
+        raise ValueError("The requested account is not enabled for auto-trading.")
+    return {
+        "account_id": account_id,
+        "account_name": account_name,
+        "account_type": account_type,
+        "is_active": is_active,
+        "auto_trading_enabled": auto_enabled,
+    }
+

+def _simulated_auto_trading_scope_digest(account_ids: list[int]) -> str:
+    """Hash the ordered canonical JSON representation of resolved IDs."""
+
+    canonical = json.dumps(account_ids, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

+def _stage_default_scope(mcp_runtime: _McpRuntime) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Preview using an omitted account_ids property, the public default scope."""
+
+    return mcp_runtime.dispatcher.call(
+        capability_key="trading.start.simulated_auto_trading",
+        arguments={"trade_date": TRADE_DATE.isoformat(), "idempotency_key": uuid4().hex},
+    )
+
+
+def _stage_explicit_scope(
+    mcp_runtime: _McpRuntime,
+    account_ids: list[int],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Preview a caller-supplied ordered account ID list."""
+
+    return mcp_runtime.dispatcher.call(
+        capability_key="trading.start.simulated_auto_trading",
+        arguments={
+            "trade_date": TRADE_DATE.isoformat(),
+            "account_ids": account_ids,
+            "idempotency_key": uuid4().hex,
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def _resume(mcp_runtime: _McpRuntime, staged: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Approve one actual dispatcher confirmation token."""
+
+    assert staged["status"] == "confirmation_required"
+    token = staged.get("confirmation_token")
+    assert isinstance(token, str) and token
+    return mcp_runtime.dispatcher.resume_confirmation(confirmation_token=token, approve=True)
+
+
+def _exchanges(log: _HttpLog, *, method: str, path: str) -> list[_Exchange]:
+    """Select observed requests without substituting any response."""
+
+    return [
+        exchange
+        for exchange in log.exchanges
+        if exchange["method"] == method and exchange["path"] == path
+    ]
+
+
+def _account_reads(log: _HttpLog) -> list[_Exchange]:
+    """Return real account-list and account-detail GETs from the API log."""
+
+    return [
+        exchange
+        for exchange in log.exchanges
+        if exchange["method"] == "GET"
+        and exchange["path"].startswith(ACCOUNT_LIST_PATH)
+    ]
+
+
+def _assert_json_response(exchange: _Exchange, status: int) -> None:
+    assert exchange["status"] == status
+    assert exchange["content_type"].startswith("application/json")
+
+
+def _assert_http_guard(log: _HttpLog) -> None:
+    assert log.blocked == [("https", "outside.invalid", 443)]
+    assert all(
+        exchange["origin"]
+        == f"{log.expected_origin[0]}://{log.expected_origin[1]}:{log.expected_origin[2]}"
+        for exchange in log.exchanges
+    )

+def test_default_scope_freezes_only_accounts_resolved_before_confirmation(
+    mcp_runtime: _McpRuntime,
+    accounts: _Accounts,
+    engine_spy: _EngineSpy,
+    exact_origin_http_log: _HttpLog,
+) -> None:
+    """A newly eligible account after preview is not added to the confirmed run."""
+
+    before_trades = SimulatedTradeModel.objects.count()
+    staged = _stage_default_scope(mcp_runtime)
+    assert staged["status"] == "confirmation_required"
+    assert staged["preview_result"]["account_ids"] is None
+    lists = _exchanges(exact_origin_http_log, method="GET", path=ACCOUNT_LIST_PATH)
+    assert len(lists) == 1
+    _assert_json_response(lists[0], 200)
+
+    added = _create_account(
+        mcp_runtime.principal.owner,
+        f"added-after-preview-{uuid4().hex[:10]}",
+    )
+    assert added.pk != accounts.eligible.pk
+
+    result = _resume(mcp_runtime, staged)
+    assert result["status"] == "completed"
+    posts = _exchanges(exact_origin_http_log, method="POST", path=AUTO_RUN_PATH)
+    assert len(posts) == 1
+    _assert_json_response(posts[0], 200)
+    assert engine_spy.calls == [(TRADE_DATE, (accounts.eligible.pk,))], (
+        "confirmation included an account added after preview: "
+        f"observed execution IDs {engine_spy.calls!r}"
+    )
+    resolved_ids = [accounts.eligible.pk]
+    assert staged["preview_result"]["resolved_account_ids"] == resolved_ids
+    scope_summary = staged["preview_result"]["account_scope_summary"]
+    assert scope_summary["scope_mode"] == "default"
+    assert scope_summary["requested_account_count"] is None
+    assert scope_summary["source_account_count"] == 2
+    assert scope_summary["resolved_account_count"] == len(resolved_ids)
+    expected_digest = hashlib.sha256(
+        json.dumps(resolved_ids, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode("utf-8")
+    ).hexdigest()
+    assert scope_summary["resolved_account_ids_sha256"] == expected_digest
+    assert posts[0]["request_json"] == {
+        "trade_date": TRADE_DATE.isoformat(),
+        "account_ids": [accounts.eligible.pk],
+    }
+    assert result["result"]["outcome"] == "noop"
+    assert SimulatedTradeModel.objects.count() == before_trades
+    added_detail_path = f"{ACCOUNT_LIST_PATH}{added.pk}/"
+    assert not _exchanges(exact_origin_http_log, method="GET", path=added_detail_path)
+    _assert_http_guard(exact_origin_http_log)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+def test_account_eligibility_is_rechecked_at_confirmation(
+    mcp_runtime: _McpRuntime,
+    accounts: _Accounts,
+    engine_spy: _EngineSpy,
+    exact_origin_http_log: _HttpLog,
+    change: str,
+    expected_status: int,
+) -> None:
+    """A preview does not authorize an account after its persisted eligibility changes."""
+
+    account = accounts.eligible
+    staged = _stage_explicit_scope(mcp_runtime, [account.pk])
+    assert staged["status"] == "confirmation_required"
+    if change == "owner_transfer":
+        account.user = mcp_runtime.principal.other
+        account.save(update_fields=["user"])
+    elif change == "inactive":
+        account.is_active = False
+        account.save(update_fields=["is_active"])
+    elif change == "real":
+        account.account_type = "real"
+        account.save(update_fields=["account_type"])
+    else:
+        account.auto_trading_enabled = False
+        account.save(update_fields=["auto_trading_enabled"])

+    before_trades = SimulatedTradeModel.objects.count()
+    result = _resume(mcp_runtime, staged)
+    assert result["status"] == "error"
+    assert result["ok"] is False
+    posts = _exchanges(exact_origin_http_log, method="POST", path=AUTO_RUN_PATH)
+    assert len(posts) == 1
+    _assert_json_response(posts[0], expected_status)
+    assert engine_spy.builds == 0 and engine_spy.calls == []

"""
AgomTradePro SDK - Simulated Trading 模拟盘交易模块

提供模拟盘交易相关的 API 操作。
"""

from datetime import date
from typing import Any, cast

from .base import BaseModule


class SimulatedTradingModule(BaseModule):
    """
    统一账户交易模块（保留 simulated_trading 名称兼容）。

    提供账户管理、交易执行、绩效查询等功能。
    """

    def __init__(self, client: Any) -> None:
        """
        初始化 SimulatedTrading 模块

        Args:
            client: AgomTradePro 客户端实例
        """
        # Canonical simulated trading endpoints are served under /api/simulated-trading/*.
        super().__init__(client, "/api/simulated-trading")

    def list_accounts(
        self,
        status: str | None = None,
        account_type: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 100,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        获取账户列表

        Args:
            status: 账户状态过滤（active/inactive/closed）
            account_type: 可选，real 或 simulated
            limit: 返回数量限制

        Returns:
            当前认证用户可访问的模拟账户列表

        Example:
            >>> client = AgomTradeProClient()
            >>> accounts = client.simulated_trading.list_accounts(status="active")
            >>> for account in accounts:
            ...     print(f"{account['name']}: {account['total_value']}")
        """
        params: dict[str, Any] = {"active_only": True, "limit": limit}
        if status is not None and status.lower() in {"inactive", "closed"}:
            params["active_only"] = False
        if account_type is not None:
            params["account_type"] = account_type

        response = self._get("accounts/", params=params)
        if isinstance(response, dict):
            return cast(list[dict[str, Any]], response.get("accounts", []))
        return cast(list[dict[str, Any]], response)

    def list_accounts_envelope(
        self,
        status: str | None = None,
        account_type: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 100,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """List accounts and preserve the API success/count/accounts envelope."""

        params: dict[str, Any] = {"active_only": True, "limit": limit}
        if status is not None and status.lower() in {"inactive", "closed"}:
            params["active_only"] = False
        if account_type is not None:
            params["account_type"] = account_type
        return self._get("accounts/", params=params)

    def get_account(self, account_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        获取单个模拟账户详情

        Args:
            account_id: 账户 ID

        Returns:
            账户详情

        Raises:
            NotFoundError: 当账户不存在时

        Example:
            >>> client = AgomTradeProClient()
            >>> account = client.simulated_trading.get_account(1)
            >>> print(f"账户名称: {account['name']}")
            >>> print(f"总市值: {account['total_value']}")
        """
        response = self._get(f"accounts/{account_id}/")
        if isinstance(response, dict):
            return cast(dict[str, Any], response.get("account", response))
        return cast(dict[str, Any], response)

    def delete_account(self, account_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        删除单个模拟账户。

        Args:
            account_id: 账户 ID

        Returns:
            删除结果
        """
        return self._delete(f"accounts/{account_id}/")

    def batch_delete_accounts(self, account_ids: list[int]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        批量删除模拟账户。

        Args:
            account_ids: 账户 ID 列表

        Returns:
            批量删除结果
        """
        return self._post("accounts/batch-delete/", json={"account_ids": account_ids})

    def create_account(
        self,
        name: str,
        initial_capital: float,
        start_date: date | None = None,
        account_type: str = "simulated",
        max_position_pct: float = 20.0,
        stop_loss_pct: float | None = 10.0,
        commission_rate: float = 0.0003,
        slippage_rate: float = 0.001,
        *,
        idempotency_key: str,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        创建账户

        Args:
            name: 账户名称
            initial_capital: 初始资金
            start_date: 起始日期（当前 canonical API 不消费该字段，保留兼容）
            account_type: 账户类型，real 或 simulated
            max_position_pct: 单资产最大持仓比例
            stop_loss_pct: 止损比例
            commission_rate: 手续费率
            slippage_rate: 滑点率
            idempotency_key: 本次提交的稳定键，网络重试必须复用；新的创建使用新键。

        Returns:
            创建的账户信息

        Raises:
            ValidationError: 当参数验证失败时

        Example:
            >>> from datetime import date
            >>> client = AgomTradeProClient()
            >>> account = client.simulated_trading.create_account(
            ...     name="测试账户",
            ...     initial_capital=1000000.0,
            ...     start_date=date(2024, 1, 1),
            ...     idempotency_key="account-create-example-1"
            ... )
            >>> print(f"账户已创建: {account['id']}")
        """
        data: dict[str, Any] = {
            "account_name": name,
            "account_type": account_type,
            "initial_capital": initial_capital,
            "max_position_pct": max_position_pct,
            "stop_loss_pct": stop_loss_pct,
            "commission_rate": commission_rate,
            "slippage_rate": slippage_rate,
        }

        response = self._post("accounts/", json=data, idempotency_key=idempotency_key)
        if isinstance(response, dict):
            return cast(dict[str, Any], response.get("account", response))
        return cast(dict[str, Any], response)

    def execute_trade(
        self,
        account_id: int,
        asset_code: str,
        side: str,
        quantity: float,
        price: float | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        执行交易

        Args:
            account_id: 账户 ID
            asset_code: 资产代码
            side: 交易方向（buy/sell）
            quantity: 数量
            price: 价格（None 表示使用市价）

        Returns:
            交易执行结果

        Raises:
            ValidationError: 当参数验证失败时
            NotFoundError: 当账户不存在时

        Example:
            >>> client = AgomTradeProClient()
            >>> result = client.simulated_trading.execute_trade(
            ...     account_id=1,
            ...     asset_code="000001.SH",
            ...     side="buy",
            ...     quantity=1000,
            ...     price=10.5
            ... )
            >>> print(f"交易已执行: {result['order_id']}")
        """
        data: dict[str, Any] = {
            "asset_code": asset_code,
            "asset_name": asset_code,
            "asset_type": "fund",
            "action": side.lower(),
            "quantity": quantity,
            "reason": "MCP simulated ETF allocation",
        }

        if price is not None:
            data["price"] = price

        return self._post(f"accounts/{account_id}/trade/", json=data)

    def get_positions(
        self,
        account_id: int,
        asset_code: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        获取模拟账户持仓

        Args:
            account_id: 账户 ID
            asset_code: 资产代码过滤（可选）

        Returns:
            持仓列表

        Example:
            >>> client = AgomTradeProClient()
            >>> positions = client.simulated_trading.get_positions(account_id=1)
            >>> for pos in positions:
            ...     print(f"{pos['asset_code']}: {pos['quantity']}")
        """
        response = self._get(f"accounts/{account_id}/positions/")
        if isinstance(response, dict):
            positions = response.get("positions", [])
            if asset_code is not None:
                positions = [p for p in positions if p.get("asset_code") == asset_code]
            return cast(list[dict[str, Any]], positions)
        return cast(list[dict[str, Any]], response)

    def get_performance(
        self,
        account_id: int,
        start_date: date | None = None,
        end_date: date | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        获取模拟账户绩效

        Args:
            account_id: 账户 ID
            start_date: 开始日期（可选）
            end_date: 结束日期（可选）

        Returns:
            绩效数据，包括收益率、最大回撤、夏普比率等

        Example:
            >>> client = AgomTradeProClient()
            >>> perf = client.simulated_trading.get_performance(account_id=1)
            >>> print(f"总收益: {perf['total_return']:.2%}")
            >>> print(f"年化收益: {perf['annual_return']:.2%}")
        """
        response = self._get(f"accounts/{account_id}/performance/")
        if isinstance(response, dict):
            return cast(dict[str, Any], response.get("performance", response))
        return cast(dict[str, Any], response)

    def get_trade_history(
        self,
        account_id: int,
        limit: int = 100,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        获取交易历史

        Args:
            account_id: 账户 ID
            limit: 返回数量限制

        Returns:
            交易历史列表

        Example:
            >>> client = AgomTradeProClient()
            >>> trades = client.simulated_trading.get_trade_history(account_id=1)
            >>> for trade in trades:
            ...     print(f"{trade['created_at']}: {trade['side']} {trade['asset_code']}")
        """
        params: dict[str, Any] = {"limit": limit}
        response = self._get(f"accounts/{account_id}/trades/", params=params)
        results = response.get("results", response)
        return cast(list[dict[str, Any]], results)

    def close_position(
        self,
        account_id: int,
        asset_code: str,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        平仓

        Args:
            account_id: 账户 ID
            asset_code: 资产代码

        Returns:
            平仓结果

        Example:
            >>> client = AgomTradeProClient()
            >>> result = client.simulated_trading.close_position(
            ...     account_id=1,
            ...     asset_code="000001.SH"
            ... )
            >>> print(f"已平仓: {result['order_id']}")
        """
        data: dict[str, Any] = {"asset_code": asset_code}

        return self._post(f"accounts/{account_id}/positions/close/", json=data)

    def reset_account(
        self,
        account_id: int,
        new_initial_capital: float | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        重置模拟账户

        Args:
            account_id: 账户 ID
            new_initial_capital: 新的初始资金（None 表示使用原值）

        Returns:
            重置后的账户信息

        Example:
            >>> client = AgomTradeProClient()
            >>> account = client.simulated_trading.reset_account(account_id=1)
            >>> print(f"账户已重置")
        """
        data: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if new_initial_capital is not None:
            data["new_initial_capital"] = new_initial_capital

        return self._post(f"accounts/{account_id}/reset/", json=data)

    def run_auto_trading(
        self,
        trade_date: date | None = None,
        account_ids: list[int] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        手动触发模拟盘自动交易。

        Args:
            trade_date: 交易日期，None 表示今天
            account_ids: 指定本人适格模拟账户；None 由服务端选择本人活跃且
                启用自动交易的模拟账户，[] 表示空范围，不执行交易。

        Returns:
            服务端原始业务结果；以 outcome 判断 success/partial/noop/blocked/failed。
            confirmed_trade_count 保留已确认成交，stored 为 None 表示写入数量不明。
        """
        data: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if trade_date is not None:
            data["trade_date"] = trade_date.isoformat()
        if account_ids is not None:
            data["account_ids"] = account_ids
        return self._post("auto-trading/run/", json=data)

    def run_daily_inspection(
        self,
        account_id: int,
        strategy_id: int | None = None,
        inspection_date: date | None = None,
        auto_create_proposal: bool = False,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        手动执行账户日更巡检并落库。
        """
        data: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if strategy_id is not None:
            data["strategy_id"] = strategy_id
        if inspection_date is not None:
            data["inspection_date"] = inspection_date.isoformat()
        if auto_create_proposal:
            data["auto_create_proposal"] = auto_create_proposal
        return self._post(f"accounts/{account_id}/inspections/run/", json=data)

    def list_daily_inspections(
        self,
        account_id: int,
        limit: int = 20,
        inspection_date: date | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        查询账户日更巡检历史报告。
        """
        params: dict[str, Any] = {"limit": limit}
        if inspection_date is not None:
            params["inspection_date"] = inspection_date.isoformat()
        return self._get(f"accounts/{account_id}/inspections/", params=params)

class CapabilityManifestValidationError(ValueError):
    """Raised when a capability manifest violates registry rules."""


def _is_supported_integer_array_schema(schema: object) -> bool:
    """Return whether a schema declares an integer array, optionally nullable."""

    if type(schema) is not dict:
        return False
    schema_type = schema.get("type")
    valid_array_type = schema_type == "array" or (
        type(schema_type) is list
        and all(type(item) is str for item in schema_type)
        and len(schema_type) == 2
        and set(schema_type) == {"array", "null"}
    )
    items = schema.get("items")
    return valid_array_type and type(items) is dict and items.get("type") == "integer"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CapabilityManifest:
    """Stable capability contract exposed through MCP core tools."""

    capability_key: str
    title: str
    summary: str
    description: str
    owner_app: str
    risk_level: str
    executor_kind: str
    executor_ref: str
    tags: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    input_schema: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    output_schema: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    requires_confirmation: bool = False
    confirmation_preview_arguments: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    confirmation_commit_arguments: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    idempotency: str = "none"
    idempotency_argument_name: str = "idempotency_key"
    requires_mcp_enabled: bool = False
    required_roles: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    audit_tags: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    legacy_tool_names: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    enabled: bool = True
    lifecycle_status: str = "active"
    deprecated_since: str = ""
    sunset_on: str = ""
    replacement_hint: str = ""
    confirmation_commit_argument_bindings: dict[str, str] = field(
        default_factory=dict, repr=False
    )

    def _lifecycle_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return lifecycle metadata only when a capability is not active."""

        if self.lifecycle_status == "active":
            return {}
        return {
            "lifecycle_status": self.lifecycle_status,
            "deprecated_since": self.deprecated_since,
            "sunset_on": self.sunset_on,
            "replacement_hint": self.replacement_hint,
        }

    def to_discovery_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return compact metadata suitable for bounded capability search."""
        return {
            "capability_key": self.capability_key,
            "title": self.title,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "owner_app": self.owner_app,
            "risk_level": self.risk_level,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "requires_confirmation": self.requires_confirmation,
            "required_roles": list(self.required_roles),
            **self._lifecycle_dict(),
        }

    def to_summary_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a stable summary payload for discovery endpoints."""
        return {
            "capability_key": self.capability_key,
            "title": self.title,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "owner_app": self.owner_app,
            "risk_level": self.risk_level,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "requires_confirmation": self.requires_confirmation,
            "idempotency": self.idempotency,
            "idempotency_argument_name": self.idempotency_argument_name,
            "required_roles": list(self.required_roles),
            "audit_tags": list(self.audit_tags),
            "legacy_tool_names": list(self.legacy_tool_names),
            **self._lifecycle_dict(),
        }

    def to_schema_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the full schema payload for one capability."""
        payload = self.to_summary_dict()
        payload.update(
            {
                "description": self.description,
                "input_schema": self.input_schema,
                "output_schema": self.output_schema,
                "requires_mcp_enabled": self.requires_mcp_enabled,
                "executor_kind": self.executor_kind,
                "confirmation_preview_arguments": self.confirmation_preview_arguments,
                "confirmation_commit_arguments": self.confirmation_commit_arguments,
            }
        )
        return payload
